name: Zaprep
description:
Zaprep is an Instagram DM and comment automation platform. Connect your Instagram Business or Creator account, set up automation rules that auto-reply to comments, DMs, and story replies, collect emails from conversations, and gate replies behind a follow.

This connector lets you manage your Zaprep workspace directly from Claude:

- List your connected Instagram accounts
- View all your automation rules and their status
- Create new automation rules — set the trigger (comment, DM, story reply, new follower), keywords, and reply actions
- Enable or disable an existing automation
- Delete an automation you no longer need

Useful for quickly checking automation status, spinning up a new comment-to-DM funnel, or cleaning up old rules — all without leaving your Claude conversation. Requires a free Zaprep account (zaprep.com) with at least one connected Instagram account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zaprep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zaprep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.zaprep.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zaprep MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zaprep provides these MCP tools: create_automation, delete_automation, list_accounts, list_automations, and toggle_automation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zaprep?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zaprep in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Zaprep requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zaprep is developed by Bytequest LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
